stories.title: Jalen Duren Signs $200M Extension With Pistons — Holdout Over

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
BREAKING: Jalen Duren and the Detroit Pistons have agreed on a 5-year, $200M fully guaranteed extension. The holdout is over. The 22-year-old All-Star averaged 19.5 pts and 10.5 reb last season. Detroit's cornerstone stays. 🏀 #Pistons
[Window: 9:00 AM ET | ~238 chars ✓]

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Duren agreed to $200M — but he was eligible for $287M. He left $87M on the table to stay in Detroit. Sometimes security beats chasing the max. The Pistons finally have their franchise center locked in. #Pistons #NBA
[Window: 11:00 AM ET | ~215 chars ✓]
